summary: Returns the value as a sheet id, or throws.
description: Apps Script numbers its sheets from zero, so a sheet id is a non-negative safe integer — the same rule `isCountable` applies. The id of the first sheet in a spreadsheet is `0`.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

params.message: The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted.
params.strict: When `true`, a string counts as empty only if it has no characters at all; by default whitespace is trimmed first.

returns: the same value, typed as a sheet id.

throws.IllegalArgumentException: the value is not a sheet id.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
requireValidSheetId(0); // => 0
requireValidSheetId(1234567890); // => 1234567890
requireValidSheetId(-1); // throws IllegalArgumentException
requireValidSheetId(1.5); // throws IllegalArgumentException
```
